versions.changelog:
birthday-trip v3.2.0

- Major overhaul of execution rules: answers must be sourced from flyai CLI output—never from training data.
- Enforced CLI-first workflow for all birthday trip flight bookings; output must include `[Book]({detailUrl})` links for every result.
- Expanded feature support to include hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, visa info, travel insurance, and car rental.
- Updated output guidance: responses must start with the best birthday-friendly option, include a comparison table, and add birthday tips.
- Added strict language matching (Chinese/English) based on user input.
